settings.text: Dry dog in, dry dog out. No muddy belly, no towel wrestling.

settings.heading: Your dog stays dry. Your floors stay
settings.text:
Most dog raincoats only cover the back. The rain still soaks the belly, the legs splash through every puddle, and you spend the next 15 minutes drying a wet dog on the doormat.

The Puddle Suit covers your dog from nose to tail. The hood has a clear face shield, and adjustable cuffs, a tail sleeve and snap-on boots close the gaps where water usually gets in. Reflective bands keep you both visible after dark.

Snap it on, walk, rinse it off, hang it to dry. That's the whole routine.

settings.title: Snug hood
settings.text: Elastic edge stays in place when your dog shakes.

settings.title: Clear face shield
settings.text: Wide-view PVC shield keeps rain off the eyes and ears without blocking vision.

settings.title: Tail sleeve
settings.text: Covers the tail so it doesn't drip water down the back.

settings.title: Snap-button chest
settings.text: Opens at the front, so nothing gets pulled over the head. A D-ring holds the leash.

settings.title: Adjustable cuffs
settings.text: Toggle cuffs keep wind and splash out. Reflective bands shine in headlights.

settings.title: Removable boots
settings.text: Snap-on boots with anti-slip soles keep paws dry and clean.

settings.title: Front legs in
settings.text: Step the front legs through and pull the hood over the head.

settings.title: Snap the chest
settings.text: Close the snap buttons under the chin and chest.

settings.title: Legs, tail & boots
settings.text: Slip the back legs and tail into their sleeves, then snap on the boots.

settings.heading: Size guide
settings.measure: Back length: base of the collar to the base of the tail. Chest: widest part of the ribcage, just behind the front legs. Neck: where the collar sits, with room for two fingers.
settings.tip: Between sizes? Pick the bigger one. Back length matters most for a full-body suit.

settings.question: What size should I get?
settings.answer: Measure your dog's back length from the base of the collar to the base of the tail, then check the size guide. Between two sizes, choose the bigger one.

settings.question: Does the face shield bother dogs?
settings.answer: The clear shield sits in front of the face, not on it, so your dog can see normally. Let your dog wear the suit indoors for a few minutes the first time, with a treat.

settings.question: Is it waterproof?
settings.answer: The high-density outer fabric makes water bead off, and the cuffs, tail sleeve and snap-on boots close the usual gaps.

settings.question: Can my dog wear it without the boots?
settings.answer: Yes. The boots snap on and off, so you can leave them off for a lighter fit or for dogs still getting used to boots.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Rinse it under the tap or hand-wash in cool water with mild soap, then hang it to dry. No tumble dryer.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: US orders usually arrive in 9–17 days; Canada, the UK and Australia in 10–20 days; most other countries in 12–25 days. You get a tracking link by email as soon as it ships.

settings.question: Will I pay customs fees or taxes?
settings.answer: No. Our prices include all taxes and import duties, so the price at checkout is the final price. If a carrier ever asks you for a fee, contact us before paying and we'll take care of it.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit or arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Contact support@suzeno.com within 30 days of delivery. If it arrives damaged or faulty, we'll refund you or send a replacement. For a different size, email us and we'll help.
